title: Ultrahuman product hero
description: A window-tall product panel inset 10px from the edges with rounded top corners, its photo or video fading into the white page at the bottom. A small uppercase product name, a short 48px headline, one line of copy and two pills (blue buy, translucent glass) sit left-middle on desktop and centred at the top on phones; the copy and then the buttons rise and fade in on load.
notes: 95% of the window tall on phones, 100% on desktop
CSS load-in (600ms), off under reduced motion; dark ink over a light photo, so pass a light image
name: ultrahuman-hero

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: small uppercase product name above the headline

props.name: media
props.description: the photo or video filling the panel (cover); a placeholder when empty

props.name: mediaLabel
props.description: describes the photo for screen readers when the placeholder shows
